props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the popup along the anchor's edge: `'start'`, `'center'`, or `'end'`.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: clearable
props.description:
Shows a clear button while a value is selected (hidden during `loading`). Backspace or
Delete on the focused trigger clears too. Clearing calls `onValueChange(null)`, then
`onClear`, and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: clearIcon
props.description: Icon used by the clear affordance.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether `Escape` closes the popup. When `false` the popup stays open and `onClosePrevented`
is called instead.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description:
Whether an outside interaction, pointer press or focus moving elsewhere, closes the popup.
When `false` the popup stays open and `onClosePrevented` is called instead. Tabbing out of
the control still closes it.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether choosing an item closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup state when `open` is not set.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selected value when `value` is not set. Read once on creation; a native form reset
restores it.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description:
Content shown in the popup when `items` is empty; nothing is rendered when omitted. A
function receives `{ selectedValue, close }`.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Whether to flip placement when the preferred side lacks space. `false` disables flipping. An
array is an ordered list of fallback `Placement` values tried in order, each `top`,
`bottom`, `left`, or `right` optionally followed by `-start` or `-end` (for example
`['top', 'bottom-end']`).

props.name: form
props.description: The `id` of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to, for a control rendered outside that form.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description:
Plain-text label of an item, used for typeahead, filtering, form values, and plain-text
displays such as an input value or tag title; does not change rendered labels.
Defaults to the string `label`, otherwise `String(value)`. In `Select` and `Combobox`,
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap in pixels between anchor and popup.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's labelable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to with
`for`. Most controls set it on their focusable element and `PinInput` on its first slot;
`Slider` and `FileUpload` set it on their hidden native input. `CheckboxGroup` and
`RadioGroup` set it on their `<fieldset>`, which the `Field` label names through
`aria-labelledby` instead of `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's
related parts (root, hidden input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it
unique on the page.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.description:
Extra disabled rule, evaluated for every item together with the current selected values;
return `true` to disable the item in addition to `item.disabled`. Disabled items cannot be
selected, highlighted, or reached by typeahead. In `MultiSelect`, a selected disabled item
keeps its tag (it cannot be removed) and survives clearing. In `Select` and `Combobox`,
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`.

props.name: itemProps
props.description:
Returns extra attributes spread on each item row, computed per item from the same state as
`itemRender`. `class`, `style`, `ref`, and the `onClick`, `onPointerMove`, and `onPointerDown`
handlers are merged with the component's own; calling `event.preventDefault()` in `onClick`
stops the selection. `id`, `tabIndex`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-disabled` stay
component-owned.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Replaces the default content of every item row (icon, label, description, and selected
check). The row element itself (`role="option"`, click and hover handling) stays owned by the
component. Receives `{ item, selected, highlighted, disabled }`; for `Select` and `Combobox`
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`. Declare the parameter even when unused: a
zero-argument function is called as an accessor, not mounted as a component.

props.name: items
props.description:
Options of the popup list: plain strings (shorthand for `{ value, label }`), item objects,
`{ type: 'group', label, children }` groups, and `{ type: 'separator' }` dividers. Item values
must be unique across the whole collection; a repeated value is ignored and logs an error
in development.

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon rendered before the selected value or placeholder.

props.name: listboxProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the listbox `div` inside the popup, such as `aria-label`, `data-*`
or an `onScroll` handler (calling `event.preventDefault()` there skips `onBottomReached`).
`id` and `tabIndex` stay component-owned.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Replaces the `trailing` icon with `loadingIcon` and hides the clear button. It does not
disable the select.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown instead of `trailing` while `loading`.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBottomReached
props.description:
Called once each time scrolling brings the listbox within `scrollThreshold` of its end,
for example to load the next page. It fires again only after the user scrolls away from the
bottom and back.

props.name: onClear
props.description:
Called after a clear action (see `clearable`), following `onValueChange(null)`. Not called
while the select is disabled or read-only.

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description:
Called, without arguments, when `Escape` or an outside interaction was blocked by
`closeOnEscape={false}` or `closeOnOutsideClick={false}`. The popup remains open.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description:
Called once each time the overlay finishes its exit after closing. It is not called while the
overlay is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next state whenever the popup should open or close (typing, arrow keys,
selecting an item, `Escape`, `Tab`, or an outside press). Not called when the state would not
change. A disabled select never opens.

props.name: onReset
props.description:
Called after a native `<form>` reset has restored the initial selection (and, in `Combobox`
and `MultiSelect`, cleared the search text). It runs in a microtask after the `reset` event
and is skipped when the event was default-prevented. In controlled mode the selection stays
at `value`, so use this callback to reset your own state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new item `value` when the user changes the selection, or with `null` when
it is cleared. Not called for prop updates, when the same item is chosen again, or while
the select is disabled or read-only.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled popup state. `undefined` keeps it uncontrolled. In controlled mode the popup
opens or closes only when you update this prop in `onOpenChange`. Page scrolling is locked
while the popup is open.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Viewport collision padding in pixels.

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Text shown in the trigger while no value is selected. Takes precedence over the
`placeholder` translation.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Preferred side of the anchor (the control) on which the popup opens. Combined with `align`;
see `flip` for when the side can change.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Locks body scroll while the popup is open. Set `false` to keep the page scrollable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: scrollThreshold
props.description: Distance from the end of the listbox, in pixels, within which `onBottomReached` fires.

props.name: shift
props.description: Cross-axis offset in pixels from the resolved placement.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: slide
props.description: Whether the popup may slide along its main axis to remain visible.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Icon at the end of the trigger; replaced by `loadingIcon` while `loading`.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Overrides the built-in messages (`clear`, `placeholder`) for this instance, merged over
the messages from the provider and locale.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description:
Receives the trigger `<button>` element — the focusable part that owns keyboard
interaction — for example to focus it programmatically. The component `ref` receives the
outer control `div` instead.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled selected value. `undefined` keeps the selection uncontrolled; `null` keeps it
controlled and empty. A value that matches no item is displayed as `String(value)`. In
controlled mode the selection changes only when you update this prop in `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text rendered under the label in the default item content. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item cannot be selected. A disabled item is also left out of form submission.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label in the default item content. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: label
props.description:
Visual label. May be any JSX; when it is not a string, plain-text uses (typeahead,
filtering) fall back to `String(value)` unless `getItemLabel` is set.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique selection and form value. Values compare by identity, so `1` and `'1'` differ.
